fichas.title: Fire Compartment Walls
fichas.summary: Fire compartment walls divide buildings into fire compartments and protect boundaries, openings, roof junctions, and building corners. The page describes their required fire resistance, construction, extent, placement, and minimum thicknesses for single-skin and two-skin wall materials.
uses: Protect party walls and building boundaries
Limit fire spread through walls and roof junctions

dimensions.label: Distance from plot boundary
dimensions.context: External wall requires a fire compartment wall when less than this distance from the plot boundary.
dimensions.ocr_raw: less than 2.50 m from the plot boundary

dimensions.label: Maximum fire compartment extent
dimensions.context: Larger buildings are subdivided into fire compartments of not more than this extent.
dimensions.ocr_raw: not more than 40 m

dimensions.label: Fire resistance rating
dimensions.context: Fire compartment walls are specified as F 90A; penetrating cables and pipes require a 90-minute fire resistance class.
dimensions.ocr_raw: (F 90A) ... 90 min fire resistance class

dimensions.label: Wall extension above roof
dimensions.context: Normal minimum extension above the roof; the page also specifies a larger minimum for soft roof coverings and industrial buildings.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 30 cm above the roof

dimensions.label: Wall extension above roof for specified cases
dimensions.context: Minimum above roof for soft roof covering and in industrial buildings.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 50 cm for a soft roof covering and in industrial buildings

dimensions.label: Internal-corner separation
dimensions.context: Fire compartment wall arrangement: locate at least this distance from internal corners, or extend into an internal corner by at least this distance to both sides or one side, according to the illustrated variants.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Arrange fire compartment wall ≥ 5 m from internal corners; Extend fire compartment wall in an internal corner by ≥ 5 m to both sides (variant 1); Extend fire compartment wall to one side by ≥5 m (variant 2); Extend fire compartment wall to both sides

dimensions.label: Distance from external corner
dimensions.context: Fire compartment wall location shown in the building-corner layout diagram.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Fire compartment wall is to be located ≤40 m from the external corner

dimensions.label: Maximum projection angle
dimensions.context: Fire compartment wall must not project at an angle over this limit.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must not project at an angle over 120°
